summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat printed the articles of agreement signed May 23, 1873, for Tom Allen and Mike McCoole to fight for $2,000 a side on September 23 within 200 miles of St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Sunday, May 25, 1873' (pre-merger; not yet the Globe-Democrat).

facts.fact: Allen and Mike McCoole signed articles of agreement to fight under the new London prize ring rules for $2,000 a side on September 23, 1873, within 200 miles of St. Louis
The agreement named Allen's house at 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis, as the place for the July 8 deposit; both men were described as residents of St. Louis

notes: McCoole told Allen 'Old boy, you must get well soon', hinting Allen was unwell, but the article gives no detail.
